[health-memberships-ambulance-concierge] Built 2026-09-30/10-02 from official provider pages fetched live (custom urllib crawler + WebFetch); WebSearch was unavailable (session search budget exhausted), so discovery relied on (a) known national programs, (b) reciprocity/participant lists published by the programs themselves (Seneca Area EMS reciprocal list for western PA; Life Flight Network FireMed/LifeMed agency terms; REMSA AAMMP partner links; ambulancemembership.com platform roster), and (c) probing official domains. Skipped as already present: AirMedCare Network and Life Flight Network (medical-physician-ambulance-billing.json), One Medical visit billing (medical-billing.json; this file adds the One Medical membership fee), Amazon Pharmacy/RxPass and Blink Health (pharmacy-labs-dme.json). Cost Plus Drugs appears in both pharmacy-labs-dme.json and here (roster) because it was explicitly in scope. COMPLETENESS: Air - all major national/regional membership sellers covered (AMCN brands, PHI Cares, Life Flight [existing], Mercy Flights, REMSA Care Flight, CareFlite, Apollo MedFlight, Survival Flight, Haynes Life Flight, LifeMed Alaska, Enloe FlightCare); checked and found NO consumer membership page for MedFlight (Ohio), North Memorial Air Care (MN), Mercy Flight (WNY), AirLife Denver, Life Link III, LifeFlight of Maine, Flight For Life; Air Methods no longer sells memberships (entry included). Ground - Oregon FireMed is well covered (12 agencies + LifeGuard platform agencies); western PA partially (MFPAA, Tri-Community South, Seneca + 13 reciprocal agencies as roster); LA/MS/TX (Acadian), OK (EMSAcare), TX/AR (LifeNet), NV/CA (REMSA, Sierra Saver). Concierge/DPC - national concierge brands (MDVIP, SignatureMD, PartnerMD, Specialdocs, Private Medical, Sollis, Duke Signature Care, Parsley, One Medical) and two DPC examples; DPC Frontier mapper shows 3,208 DPC practices (2,647 pure, 453 hybrid) which are NOT individually enumerated (mapper exposes coordinates only). Telehealth/Rx - Teladoc, Amwell, MDLIVE, Sesame Plus, PlushCare, Ro, GoodRx Companion (formerly Gold), with SingleCare, Cost Plus, Walgreens Prescription Savings Club, K Health and Doctor On Demand at roster tier because their sites blocked automated fetch. REVIEW PASS 2026-10-02 (second agent): WebSearch budget still exhausted and WebFetch hit a session limit, so the review used curl plus a read-only browser pane (which gets past the Cloudflare/403 blocks that stopped the first pass). All 166 URLs in the file were status-checked; fixed redirected AirMedCare FAQ/apply URLs, a dead Pioneer LifeGuard form link, and Seneca EMS (https certificate fails; http works). Content re-verified on about 30 entries. Changes: MASA rebranded to 'Medical Access & Service Advantage' (masaaccess.com) and is now fully detailed (phone, renewal, auto-renew, plan prices); Enloe FlightCare verified (Cognito Forms enrollment); the AMCN brand pointers now note the $9/month recurring option, non-refundable terms and the site contact line 833-819-3454; GoodRx Companion, PlushCare, Parsley, Sesame and Ro gained cancel, invoice and receipt help articles. Parsley's Medicare note was corrected: its clinicians have opted out of Medicare. PlushCare auto-enrolls first-visit patients in a 30-day trial that then bills. Apollo MedFlight eligibility corrected to TX and OK. Ross/West View EMS turned out to be a MANDATORY municipal annual EMS fee collected by Jordan Tax Service, not a voluntary subscription, and was reclassified. West Deer EMS, Doctor On Demand, SingleCare (free; no bill) and Cost Plus were upgraded to detailed. K Health no longer shows consumer pricing; it now sells to health systems. ADDED: Airlift Northwest (WA/AK, $85/yr, eServices, no auto-renew yet), Air St. Luke's (ID), Lancaster EMS (PA; senior rates $55/$75) and Good Fellowship Ambulance (West Chester PA; senior rates $65/$90). Still no ground-ambulance subscription found for OH, MN or KS. Domain guessing for Missoula, Tri-State (WI/MN), Valley Med Flight, Cal-Ore Life Flight, Mountain Lifeflight and Air Idaho Rescue found nothing usable. Many program sites also publish no auto-renew or cancel page; for those the links stay null and the notes say to call. PASS 3 (2026-10-02, third agent): WebSearch worked for ~20 queries before the session budget ran out, then discovery continued with curl probes of official domains, the amr.net and airmedcarenetwork.com sitemaps, and a read-only browser for Cloudflare-blocked city pages (bot-challenge pages such as Pasadena's were left unread, not bypassed). ADDED 71 entries: ground subscriptions in CO (Arvada, North Metro Fire, AMR Pueblo), AZ (Golder Ranch, Arizona Fire & Medical Authority - Sun City West area), NV (Storey County), KS/MO (AMR LifeCare Topeka, Kansas City metro, Linn County - closing the Kansas gap), MI (Emergent Health Member Plus, Livonia), NC (Wake $60, Johnston $60, Gaston GEMS-Care), VA (Franklin), FL (Pinellas Sunstar FirstCare), TX (Bedford, Hurst, Crowley, Jacksonville, UT Health East Texas), OK (Edmond utility-bill program), AR/LA/MS/OK/TX (Pafford; AMR Mississippi), KY/TN (KenTenn), ID (Ada County Vital Ride), IN (New Haven), DE (Millville), CA (Burbank, Fullerton, Monterey Park, Arcadia, Pasadena roster), more Oregon (Polk County, Keizer Capital FireMed, Canby, Woodburn, South Lane, AMR Josephine Paramed) and Pennsylvania (EmergyCare Erie, TowerDIRECT, VMSC, Central Bucks, Suburban, NOVA, Longwood, East Pennsboro, South Central, Susquehanna Twp, First Capital York, Silver Spring, Penn Mahoning, Pittston Twp, NorthWest EMS, Harmony; Plum EMS upgraded). AIR/TRAVEL: MedFlight of Ohio DOES sell a membership (Advantage $69.99; Global $269.99/$369.99; ages 18-75, auto-renews), which corrects pass 1; plus BannerAir (AZ), Hawaii Life Flight, Rural Medevac Alliance, legacy AeroCare/CALSTAR, and the travel-transport memberships Medjet (Diamond tier for ages 75-84), SkyMed and Global Rescue. AMCN brand entries now point to the AMCN support form that handles cancellation, billing updates and replacement cards. TELEHEALTH/CONCIERGE: LifeMD+ (monthly auto-renew; cancel in portal), Lemonaid, Hims & Hers, Talkspace, BetterHelp and Noom (roster); Concierge Choice Physicians upgraded to detailed; Baptist Health South Florida concierge added. Walgreens Prescription Savings Club URL now loads an 'Rx Savings Finder' coupon page, so the paid club appears to be discontinued. STILL MISSING: no ground subscription found for Minnesota (North Memorial, Ridgeview and others show none) or Washington (WA cities use mandatory utility-bill ambulance fees, e.g. Walla Walla, rather than voluntary memberships; Airlift Northwest and Life Flight cover air). Ohio is covered by MedFlight only on the air side. Thousands of small volunteer-corps subscription drives (PA, NJ, NY, DE, MD) and city programs (TX, CA, CO) exist; this file has the larger and representative ones, not every corps. The national DPC universe (about 3,200 practices per DPC Frontier) is not enumerated. Hospital-system concierge programs beyond Duke and Baptist South Florida (Cleveland Clinic, Penn, Hopkins, Mount Sinai and others) could not be confirmed: pages 404'd or blocked fetch. REVIEWER PASS 2026-10-02: 162 entries (130 detailed, 32 roster, 150 verified). WebSearch was unavailable (session budget exhausted), so the review could not do new open-web discovery. It used a curl status sweep of all 398 URLs in the file and about 45 WebFetch/API page reads. Many zero-status (000) or 403 results are bot blocks: costplusdrugs, singlecare, goodrx and plushcare support, UW Airlift NW, enloe, lemsa, and city sites (Burbank, Fullerton, Hurst, Crowley). For Zendesk help centers, articles were confirmed through the public /api/v2/help_center endpoints instead of the blocked pages. FIXES: (1) Shaler Area EMS website shems.org was a German religious-community site; it is now null and the entry is unverified. (2) Talkspace and Hims & Hers were upgraded to detailed with billing-history, invoice, cancel and payment articles; Talkspace therapy is Medicare Part B covered, which is noted. (3) BetterHelp got its FAQ/contact links. LifeMD+ got cancel and Medicare articles. GoodRx Companion got terms and legacy Gold links. (4) Prices, renewal rules and phones were refreshed from live pages for Pinellas FirstCare (now $89/$133, April-March year, application URL), Mercy Flights (membership phone 541-858-2646), EMSAcare, REMSA, Survival Flight, MFPAA (eServices subscribe URL), Wake, Ada, North Metro, Storey, Acadian, PHI Cares, MedFlight, Life Flight/FireMed, MDVIP, KerixHealth, Sollis (regional phones), Pafford and Concierge Choice. (5) Bend FireMed appears in BOTH Life Flight Network and AMCN FireMed terms; this is noted. (6) Added 5 AMCN FireMed agencies as roster entries: Crescent RFPD, Blue Mountain Hospital, Crook County, Harney District, Rocky Point/Chemult. (7) Every AMCN brand entry now notes that the general AMCN terms do not spell out annual auto-renewal; confirm by phone. (8) SingleCare is confirmed free (no recurring bill). KNOWN REMAINING GAPS: autopay_cancel and statements_history are still null for most local ground-subscription programs, because these are annual mail or online renewals with no auto-renew or statement feature. Nine western-PA reciprocal agencies are roster/unverified with no confirmed website. AMR Mississippi is still unverified because its page returns HTTP 500. Pasadena is bot-challenged. There is no new open-web discovery of OH, MN or WA ground programs, of hospital concierge programs (Cleveland Clinic concierge URL 404s), or of Tri-State CareFlight and Life Flight Eagle (unreachable or bot-challenged). Everside Health (large DPC) no longer exists at everside.com, which is now an unrelated investment firm.

[pharmacy-labs-dme] [Updated 2026-09-30 after link backfill + reviewer pass] File now has 1,638 entries: 135 detailed (126 verified) and 1,503 roster; 405 entries verified overall. Detailed link fill: view_bill 78, pay_bill 101, autopay_setup 29, autopay_cancel 25, statements_history 53, paperless 21, payment_assistance 69; payment_processor 91. Reviewer pass: status-checked all 379 URLs on detailed entries (363 returned 200; the rest were bot walls or HTTP/2 timeouts that load with HTTP/1.1, e.g. Kroger, Hoveround, Liberator, PatientWallet portals) and keyword-checked 370 link fields against page text. Removed two autopay_setup links whose pages do not describe autopay (Labcorp: payment plans only and card deleted after each payment; Byram: automatic shipments, not payments). Repointed Inogen and Solara autopay/statement/paperless links from the portal root to the Brightree hmebillpay FAQ, and filled the same FAQ links for Nationwide Medical and Reliable Respiratory. Pacific Medical now has its PersonaPay pay link and confirmed contact data. Payment processors were filled for BAYADA (PatientNotebook), Sonic AP and Aegis (PersonaPay) and Coram (InstaMed). Senderra Specialty Pharmacy was added. Elixir is now MedImpact, noted on the MedImpact entry. Spot-checked 9 of the 176 DME websites added by DBA mapping against the NPPES API, and all DBAs matched (for example Cashflow Solutions = Lympha Press and Roth Medical = Summit Respiratory). No roster DME supplier at or above 30,000 Medicare beneficiaries remains roster-tier; Express Healthcare, with 29,761, is the largest. Earlier text below may quote older counts. 1593 entries (108 detailed, 1485 roster). Checked against: (1) the CMS 2024 DME-by-supplier file; every non-pharmacy organizational supplier with 2,000 or more Medicare beneficiaries is present as a detailed or roster entry, and the largest (Lincare, Apria, AdaptHealth family, Byram, North Coast/Advanced Diabetes Supply, Edgepark, 180 Medical, Hanger, Solara, US MED, Rotech, Numotion, Breg, ZOLL LifeVest, VieMed, Strive) are detailed. Websites were added this pass for 44 more high-volume roster suppliers by probing the likely domain and confirming the homepage name and city. (2) The CMS Dialysis Facility listing: DaVita, Fresenius, U.S. Renal Care, DCI (securebillpay portal), Innovative Renal Care/ARA, Satellite Healthcare and Northwest Kidney Centers are detailed; all other chains and independent facilities (~880) are roster entries with phone. (3) CMS Home Health and Hospice listings: national chains are detailed or roster (Enhabit now bills through ClearBalance/Doorstep digital statements), but the ~12k agencies and ~6.7k hospices are NOT listed one by one; use the CMS files in sources. Medicare pays home health and hospice in full for eligible patients, so bills there are rare (hospice room and board and private-duty care are the exceptions). (4) Pharmacies: national, grocery, PBM mail-order, specialty and LTC pharmacies are hand-curated. This pass also harvested the NPPES registry (all community/retail pharmacy NPIs by ZIP prefix), which surfaced 17 regional chains that were missing (Medicap, Lewis Drug, Coborn's, NuCara, Yoke's, Fruth, Realo, AHF, Hayat, King Kullen, Big Y, Save Mart, Market Basket, WinCo, Homeland, Reasor's, ARcare). About 38k independent pharmacies are in rosters/pharmacies_independent_nppes.csv, with one pointer entry here. Retail pharmacies usually collect copays at pickup and do not send monthly bills; independent pharmacies' house charge accounts are the main exception. (5) Labs: Quest, Labcorp, BioReference, the Sonic Healthcare USA family (CPL, Sunrise, Clinical Labs of Hawaii, anatomic pathology), TriCore, ACL and the main genetic/oncology labs are detailed. Blocked or JS-only sites: walmart.com and samsclub.com (CAPTCHA), Kroger-family domains (connection refused), H-E-B help (JavaScript), Mark Cuban Cost Plus, Liberator Medical, AllianceRx, Mayo Clinic Labs and Enovis/DJO (403), Sonora Quest (single-page app), PathGroup (JavaScript challenge), and the Caremark help center (JavaScript app). Walmart, Kroger and H-E-B details come from search snippets and are marked verified=false. Documented autopay: AdaptHealth (mandatory AutoPAY for rentals), Medical Service Company, Rotech (by phone), 180 Medical, BAYADA, Hanger/InstaMed, Inogen/hmebillpay, Express Scripts (charge on ship), Walgreens ExpressPay, CVS Specialty (scheduled monthly payments), Innovative Renal Care, HDIS auto-ship. DaVita's InstaMed portal explicitly has NO autopay. Common processors: InstaMed, hmebillpay.com, AR Allegiance CollectPay (US MED, VieMed, Binson's, Norco), PatientWallet (180 Medical, Amerita), PatientNotebook (Soleo, Onco360), DXLink and payments.sonichealthcareusa.com (Sonic labs), Simplee/Flywire, PayTrace (Numotion), securebillpay.net (DCI, NWKC), e-BillExpress (Genoa), XIFIN, iLabBill. Rite Aid closed all pharmacies; its records page sends patients to the pharmacy that received their prescriptions. Kroger Specialty Pharmacy is now BioPlus. Still missing: detailed support pages for Walmart, Sam's Club, Kroger, H-E-B and the other grocery chains; regional hospital outreach labs and pathology groups (usually billed under the hospital, see the medical category); PathGroup, AEL and Poplar billing pages; individual home health and hospice agencies; DME suppliers under 2,000 Medicare beneficiaries (in the CMS file); websites for most smaller programmatic DME roster entries.

REVIEWER PASS (2026-09-29, second pass): Web search budget was exhausted, so all checks used direct fetches and curl. (1) Link health: curl-checked all ~317 distinct URLs in detailed entries. Most return 200. Timeouts or 403s are bot protection (Kroger, Express Scripts, Soleo, ACL, Natera and others). Publix login returned 404 and was fixed to rx.publix.com/en/mypatients. Solara's portal redirects to adapthealthsolara.hmebillpay.com and was updated. Option Care's pay-bill page redirects to PatientSimple and now uses the target. (2) Re-fetched and verified the content of about 30 detailed entries: Apria, AdaptHealth (guest-pay URL; AutoPAY cancel by phone), Rotech (portal myrotechportal.com), Byram (hardship waiver), CCS Medical, 180 Medical, Aeroflow (mail address), Lincare (billerpayments.com guest pay), Quest (paperless and history in MyQuest), Labcorp (mail address, portal), Exact Sciences (PatientWallet, mail address), BioReference, Express Scripts (AutoPay cancel under Account preferences), CVS retail, Costco, Walgreens (ExpressPay delete), CenterWell Pharmacy, Optum Rx, Accredo, DaVita, Fresenius, Enhabit, Amedisys, Numotion, Option Care, Publix, Solara, Inogen and Hanger. Optum Rx customer-service phones no longer include the Medicare fraud line or the prescriber prior-auth line. Numotion's note wrongly called NSM an alias. Walmart, Kroger, H-E-B, CVS Caremark, Sonora Quest, Edgepark and Amazon help could not be fetched again (CAPTCHA, reset, JavaScript shell, timeout or 503). (3) Completeness: re-joined the CMS DMEPOS 2024 supplier file on normalized names and found 76 suppliers with 2,000 or more beneficiaries that were not matched by name. 16 are subsidiaries of existing brands (Apria, Byram, Lincare Pharmacy, Binson's, Rotech, Tactile, AdaptHealth West/MN/MO, MiniMed, Shield CA, Accredo, Coram, Hoveround) and are noted on those entries. About 20 are orthopedic or physician practices and hospitals that belong in the medical category. The other 40 were added as roster entries. The earlier claim that every supplier with 2,000 or more beneficiaries was present was therefore not fully accurate. Also added as detailed entries: National Seating & Mobility, PathGroup, Interpath Laboratory, Addus HomeCare and Capsule Pharmacy. Added The Pennant Group as a roster entry. Duplicates merged: 'United States Medical Supply, Llc' into US MED, 'Kindred Hospice (now Gentiva)' into Gentiva, and 'Encompass / Enhabit legacy' into Enhabit. Spectra Laboratories (Fresenius renal lab) sold assets to Quest, noted on the Quest and Fresenius entries. Four CMS suppliers with very high Medicare payment per beneficiary (Sunshine Senior Solutions, Almaz Med Supply, Express Healthcare, Southeastern Medequip) now carry a data flag telling seniors to check their Medicare Summary Notice.

REVIEWER PASS 3 (2026-09-30): The file now has 1637 entries (116 detailed, 1521 roster, 221 verified=true). The web-search budget was already used up, so checks used curl and sitemaps, and a real browser pane for JavaScript-only or bot-protected sites. CAPTCHA and Cloudflare challenges were NOT bypassed: H-E-B (Imperva block), AllianceRx (Cloudflare challenge) and Cost Plus Drugs (page would not render) are still uncaptured.

(4) Upgraded to detailed: Sonora Quest (pay.sonoraquest.com, automated pay line 800-853-4288, PO Box 52880 Phoenix, no Doxo partnership), Remedi SeniorCare (LTC pharmacy, e-BillExpress portal) and Liberator Medical (B. Remaining gaps: H-E-B, AllianceRx, Cost Plus Drugs and Sam's Club billing pages; Poplar Healthcare (domain not confirmed; not added); the official AEL domain; autopay-cancel documentation, which most DME/lab billers do not publish (cancel is by phone). [Link backfill 2026-09-30] Detailed entries now 134 (116 + 18 upgraded roster suppliers with 30k+ Medicare beneficiaries). Detailed link fill: view_bill 78, pay_bill 100, autopay_setup 29 (22%), autopay_cancel 23 (17%), statements_history 52 (39%), paperless 20 (15%), payment_assistance 68. Method: crawled each detailed biller's sitemap/robots and existing billing pages, scanned candidate pages for autopay/card-on-file, statement/receipt/history, paperless, rental and assistance wording, and added only links whose page text matched; facts without a dedicated page (e.g., 'call billing to stop autopay', 'card deleted after each payment', 'no card on file required') went into notes. Many labs, home-health and hospice billers publish no autopay/paperless pages at all (one-time bills or Medicare-paid care), and the big retail/PBM pharmacy sites (CVS, Caremark, Walmart, Kroger, Amazon, H-E-B, Optum Rx) block automated fetches or render help content client-side, so their autopay/receipt pages remain partly unfilled. DME websites: the top 400 website-less roster DME suppliers by 2024 Medicare beneficiaries (rosters/dme_suppliers_cms_2024.csv) were processed; 176 got a website confirmed by fetch (homepage name/title match plus NPPES phone/city/ZIP/street match, a chain/health-system page named in the NPPES DBA, or an AdaptHealth/Rotech company page), and 383 got an NPPES phone plus practice address. Roster entries still without a website: 1208 (879 dialysis facilities/chains, which bill through the facility, plus 329 DME suppliers: ~220 from the top 400 where no site could be confirmed and all suppliers below ~2,400 beneficiaries, which were not probed). Upgraded to detailed: Sunshine Senior Solutions, DJO (Enovis/PersonaPay), DEGC (=CCS Medical), Main Street DME, Med Star (=AdaptHealth NY), Almaz Med Supply, Pacific Medical, Verus (AdaptHealth), Absolute Medical Supplies Services, Ocean Home Health (AdaptHealth), ND Medical Solutions, JL Webb DME (Priority 1 Medical Equipment), Prism Medical Products, Wound Care Concepts (Gentell), KCI USA (Solventum), Tricounty Medical Equipment, Surgi-Care and Nationwide Medical. Six of these (Sunshine, Main Street, Almaz, Absolute, ND Medical, JL Webb) have no website and unusually high Medicare payments per beneficiary; they carry a fraud-awareness note instead of billing links (Express Healthcare, 29.8k beneficiaries, stays roster with a similar flag). Second reviewer pass 2026-09-30: re-status-checked all 387 detailed-entry URLs (all resolve except Kroger, which resets bot connections, and pages behind bot walls that return 403/202: Pacific Medical, Liberator, Soleo, PathGroup, Amerita/ES PatientWallet) and keyword-checked every autopay/statement/paperless/assistance link against page text. Fixes: NSM payment_assistance cleared (its payment page offers no assistance); HDIS note corrected (public FAQ only documents changing the Personalized Delivery Plan, not card-on-file charging). New domain-variant probing (legal name and NPPES DBA, abbreviations like homemed/hme) found websites the first pass missed: Regional Home Care (regionalhc.com, 29.5k beneficiaries), Medical Services of America (msahealthcare.com, DBA Medi Home Care), Performance Modalities (performancehomemed.com, DBA Performance Home Medical, 23.8k), Synergy Orthopedics (synergyortho.com), Gould's Discount Medical (domain now redirects to AdaptHealth, so it is an AdaptHealth brand) and 21 smaller suppliers; each was confirmed by matching the NPPES phone or practice city on the fetched page. Regional Home Care, Medical Services of America and Performance Home Medical were upgraded to detailed with Brightree hmebillpay portal links, pay-by-phone and mail addresses. After review 2: 1638 entries, 138 detailed (129 verified), 430 verified overall. Detailed link fill: view_bill 81, pay_bill 104, autopay_setup 32, autopay_cancel 25, statements_history 56, paperless 24, payment_assistance 70; payment_processor 94. Caveat: most autopay_cancel links reuse the setup/portal page where the page only says autopay or the card is managed there; only Medical Service Company publishes an explicit 'Can I stop AutoPay?' answer, and the notes say when cancelling requires a phone call. 1182 roster DME suppliers (mostly under ~2,000 Medicare beneficiaries) still have no website; WebSearch was unavailable in this pass, so remaining gaps were only probed by domain guessing. KCI/Solventum still has no public patient-billing page or phone, and the 7 website-less 30k+ suppliers (Sunshine Senior Solutions, Main Street DME, Almaz, Absolute Medical, ND Medical, JL Webb/Priority 1, Prism Medical Products, Tricounty) remain unverified with NPPES phones only.
